name: Archify — 50.4K Stars; Code → Interactive Architecture Diagrams
hook: 50.4K stars (+82% growth this week) for the AI agent skill that turns any codebase or system description into a self-contained interactive HTML artifact. Five diagram types (architecture, workflow, sequence, data flow, lifecycle), four presets, dark/light themes, built-in motion animations, and export to PNG/SVG/WebM/share cards — no external dependencies. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode, and Gemini CLI. MIT.

name: JuliusBrussee/caveman — 103.9K Stars; 65% Output Token Cut
hook: 103.9K stars — well past the 100K milestone. Compresses agent prose into terse caveman-speak while keeping code, commands, and error output byte-perfect. Two independent benchmarks measured 65–75% fewer output tokens with no accuracy loss. v2.5.0 (Sept 2) adds `/caveman-compress` for CLAUDE.md and memory files (~46% input token savings on each future session). MIT skill, BSL-1.1 proxy runtime.

name: OthmanAdi/planning-with-files — 26.6K Stars; Crash-Proof Manus-Style Planning

Session recovery averaged 5.0 turns vs 13.3 without it in internal tests. Compatible with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, 60+ agents.
